name: reed-smd
title: Reed switch, surface mount
summary: Surface-mount reed switch (Littelfuse MDSM-4 class): a hollow borosilicate glass envelope with tapered seals and two matte-tin leads, each a round wire through its seal flattened into a reed blade inside (the blades overlap at the centre, a contact gap apart), bent down outside to a flattened foot (tube_length, tube_diameter, height, bend_span, span, foot_width and the estimated wire, seal and blade sizes).
provenance: Original work, authored through SolidCraft's commands by `cargo test -p sparksmith-solidcraft --test author_parts -- --ignored` (`author_parts/families.rs`); dimensions from Littelfuse's public MDSM-4 datasheet (MDSM-4 15.3 mm Surface Mount Reed Switch, Dimensions and Recommended Land Pattern; littelfuse.com, a copy at https://cdn.components.ru/media/PDF/3493878.pdf downloaded 18 November 2026): envelope 15.24 × Ø2.28 mm max, 17.52 mm over the legs, 19.30 mm overall, 2.84 mm high, feet 1.00 mm wide; wire, seals, wall and blades estimated. No CAD or EDA library data was copied; product photographs were only looked at for comparison.
